subject: English
passage: The National Wildlife Federation wants to document every endangered species habitat in North America, and it is asking citizen scientists to help. Dara Chea Rodriguez and Tian Su are just two of the many volunteer researchers who ______ to the initiative since it launched in 2015.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation:
Choice B is the best answer. The convention being tested is the use of verbs to express tense in a sentence. In this choice, the present perfect tense verb "have contributed," used in conjunction with the phrase "since it launched in 2015," correctly indicates that volunteer researchers have contributed in the past and continue to do so in the present.

Why A is incorrect:

Choice A is incorrect because the present tense verb "contribute" is inconsistent with the phrase "since it launched in 2015," which suggests that the contributions occurred in the past and continue into the present.
